summary: Display trigger for the race-laps string. The prologue increments a byte at a2+95 by a1 and then executes a corrupted indirect call with an icebp trap, both flagged by the decompiler as unreliable due to bad/positive stack pointer values. The reliable core looks up the season races section via SeasonRacesSectionFinder, searches it for the "racelaps" string key through StringKeyedLinkedListSearch, reads the entry data with DataEntryAccessor, and feeds the result to UIStringComparison. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Increment the byte at a2+95 by the register-passed value a1; this prologue operates on a corrupted stack frame whose layout is not trustworthy.

Indirect call at v5-117 followed by an icebp trap; v5 is an uninitialized local and the decompiler reports bad/positive sp values, so this call target and its effect are unknowable from the raw source.
Only proceed when SeasonRacesSectionFinder(0) returns a nonzero season races section.
Search the season data linked list for the "racelaps" string key with StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(aRacelaps).
Only continue when the "racelaps" node v2 was found (nonzero).
Extract the entry data from the found node via DataEntryAccessor(v2).
Pass the extracted data to UIStringComparison(v3) to display the race-laps string.
